name: Transportpattern
description: To reduce dimensionality of large data collections.
scenarios: The rive water has pollution from a location, after a certain time.  A package left Auckland, New Zealand, at 5:45am on 01/06/2012 and arrived in Los Angeles, USA, on 01/12/2012.
competency_questions: What is the extent of a point source pollution event? Where did a voyage begin, and where did it end?
